subject.title: Feature: configurable bootstrap file injection order for prompt cache optimization

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `agents` config surface for bootstrap dynamic-file classification and file order, or solve volatile bootstrap cache invalidation through an existing context/session mechanism instead?
rationale: The source issue is clear, but adding `bootstrapDynamicFiles` or `bootstrapFileOrder` creates a public prompt/config contract that must fit OpenClaw's config-surface bar and future context-engine ownership.

options.title: Design core config contract
options.body: Add an explicit documented config surface for dynamic bootstrap files and ordering, with schema/help/docs and prompt-boundary regression tests.

options.title: Route to context/session design
options.body: Decline new per-file config for now and resolve the operator cost problem through context-engine/session-freeze behavior or a broader cache policy.

options.title: Docs-only mitigation
options.body: Document the current limitation and recommended volatile-file practices while leaving product behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Design core config contract
recommendation.body: Add an explicit documented config surface for dynamic bootstrap files and ordering, with schema/help/docs and prompt-boundary regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent authored the current stable/dynamic heartbeat ordering and adjacent context-injection work, making him the best history-backed owner for the config/API choice.
